Directory for interactive apps covering data analysis, visualization and
modelling. Each app ships inside its R package.

::: {.callout-warning}
### Cloud hosting retired

Apps that were previously hosted in the browser are **no longer available**.
There is currently no browser version of any of them. Run them locally with R
using the commands below.
:::

## Run locally today with xplorerr

Install once, then launch any app from your R console:

```r
install.packages("xplorerr")

xplorerr::app_descriptive()         # descriptive statistics
xplorerr::app_vistributions()      # probability distributions
xplorerr::app_inference()          # hypothesis testing
xplorerr::app_linear_regression()  # linear regression
xplorerr::app_logistic_regression() # logistic regression
xplorerr::app_rfm_analysis()       # RFM / customer segmentation
xplorerr::app_visualizer()         # data visualization
```

Docs: [xplorerr.rsquaredacademy.com](https://xplorerr.rsquaredacademy.com/) ·
CRAN: [xplorerr](https://cran.r-project.org/package=xplorerr) ·
Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/aravindhebbali/xplorerr)

## App directory

Browser apps will be published on the relevant package site when they are
ready. In the meantime each app runs locally.

| App | Covers | Run locally | Docs |
|:----|:-------|:------------|:-----|
| **descriptr** | descriptive statistics | `app_descriptive()` | [docs](https://descriptr.rsquaredacademy.com/) |
| **vistributions** | probability distributions | `app_vistributions()` | [docs](https://vistributions.rsquaredacademy.com/) |
| **inferr** | hypothesis testing | `app_inference()` | [docs](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com/) |
| **olsrr** | linear regression | `app_linear_regression()` | [docs](https://olsrr.rsquaredacademy.com/) |
| **blorr** | logistic regression | `app_logistic_regression()` | [docs](https://blorr.rsquaredacademy.com/) |
| **rfm** | customer segmentation | `app_rfm_analysis()` | [docs](https://rfm.rsquaredacademy.com/) |
| **xplorerr** | all of the above + visualizer | `app_visualizer()` | [docs](https://xplorerr.rsquaredacademy.com/) |

Prefer the package that owns the app? Each package also exports its own
launcher, which is arguably the more natural entry point:

```r
olsrr::ols_launch_app()             # linear regression
blorr::blr_launch_app()             # logistic regression
rfm::rfm_launch_app()               # customer segmentation
descriptr::ds_launch_shiny_app()    # descriptive statistics
inferr::ifr_launch_shiny_app()      # hypothesis testing
vistributions::vdist_launch_app()   # probability distributions
xplorerr::app_linear_regression()   # and the rest
```

All packages: [pkgs.rsquaredacademy.com](https://pkgs.rsquaredacademy.com/)
